create.name: Jay Chodagam
create.bio:
Jay Chodagam is a meditation teacher in the San Francisco Bay Area who spent eighteen years living in an ashram and training as a monk before returning to ordinary working life. He also studied engineering at the University of Texas at Austin, and has been teaching meditation since 2004, in more than sixty countries. His teaching pairs contemplative practice with what neuroscience has found about attention and emotion, and he frames it around what he calls spiritual quotient: being as well as doing.

Every other Sunday morning he leads a free live guided meditation, streamed on YouTube and Insight Timer, and his recorded library covers breathwork, loving-kindness, forgiveness, gratitude and meeting difficult emotions, along with talks on themes such as spiritual bypassing and dreams. In the Bay Area he hosts small Heartful Dinner Conversations in Mountain View and occasional Zen dinner gatherings in Marin that combine meditation, breathwork and conversation, and over the past decade he has led more than a hundred retreats, from Italy and Montana to Bali. He has spoken at TEDxGoldenGatePark, has led sessions for companies such as Google and Gap, and runs the Joyful Living community group on Insight Timer.
